biotools.summary: Ultra-fast spatial transcriptomics deconvolution using structure-preserving randomized sketching. FlashDeconv estimates cell type proportions from spatial transcriptomics data (Visium, Visium HD, Stereo-seq, Xenium) with O(N) time complexity, processing 1 million spots in approximately 3 minutes on CPU without requiring GPU acceleration.
